summary: SkillSeed backend + Expo mobile web frontend tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed (health, profile auto-create + patch, careers list/filter/detail, skills, missions list + complete idempotency, discover questions + analyze with profile update, Nova chat multi-turn with Claude Sonnet 4.5, Nova TTS producing valid base64 audio, STT input validation). Frontend: onboarding renders Nova greeting text, name input + next flow advances to /discover (discover-screen visible with 4 question progress), skip flow from ready step lands on home-screen with home-nova-voice-btn and home-today-mission, tab-explore shows 15 career cards, tab-grow shows 8 mission cards, tab-profile visible, Nova modal opens with nova-text-input, message send returns coherent Claude reply, mission-card tap -> detail -> mission-complete-btn -> mission-complete-screen with '+30 growth points' celebration. Only issue found: expo-file-system TTS auto-play warning ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading Base64)') on web — TTS backend works but web autoplay fails silently, likely uses removed FileSystem.EncodingType.Base64 constant. Also several deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, makeDirectoryAsync).

ui_bugs.issue: Assistant/user chat bubbles do NOT have per-message testIDs (e.g. nova-message-<id>) — task description mentions verifying 'at least one message from Nova bubble visible'. Content is visible in DOM (verified via innerText) but no stable testID for automation.

integration_issues.issue: Console warning: 'speak failed TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading Base64)'. TTS backend returns valid base64 audio but web player in src/hooks/useNovaVoice.ts likely uses expo-file-system FileSystem.EncodingType.Base64 which is undefined in expo-file-system 19.x new API. Nova replies appear in text but audio does not auto-play. Non-blocking on device (native audio path) but broken on web preview.

issues: Deprecation warnings: shadow* style props (use boxShadow), props.pointerEvents (use style.pointerEvents), expo-file-system.makeDirectoryAsync (migrate to new File/Directory API).

action_items: Fix TTS autoplay on web in /app/frontend/src/hooks/useNovaVoice.ts — replace deprecated FileSystem.EncodingType.Base64 with a web-safe base64->Blob->URL playback path (or use `data:audio/mpeg;base64,` src directly with an HTMLAudioElement on web).
(Optional) Add testID='nova-message-<n>' to each chat bubble in /app/frontend/app/nova.tsx for reliable automation.
(Optional) Migrate expo-file-system usages from makeDirectoryAsync to new File/Directory API to remove deprecation warnings.
(Optional) Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents to remove RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is well-structured (~510 lines, still under 700). MongoDB _id properly excluded via projection everywhere.

rca_of_issue: TTS Web Autoplay: expo-file-system v19 deprecated the module-level `FileSystem.EncodingType` enum. Code in useNovaVoice.ts likely does `FileSystem.EncodingType.Base64` which is now undefined -> throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading Base64)'. Fix: for web platform, decode base64 to Blob and play via `new Audio(URL.createObjectURL(blob))` or use `data:audio/mpeg;base64,${b64}` directly; for native, use expo-audio Player from a base64-decoded temp file using the new File API.
